mapper.select: SELECT p.product_name FROM supplier_product sp JOIN product p ON p.product_id = sp.product_id WHERE sp.supplier_id = #{supplierId} ORDER BY p.product_id
SELECT s.supplier_name FROM supplier_product sp JOIN supplier s ON s.supplier_id = sp.supplier_id WHERE sp.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY s.supplier_id
mapper.sql: SELECT pu.purchase_id, c.customer_name, s.supplier_name, p.product_name, pu.quantity, pu.unit_price, pu.purchased_at, ps.service_type, ps.service_note FROM purchase pu JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = pu.customer_id JOIN supplier s ON s.supplier_id = pu.supplier_id JOIN product p ON p.product_id = pu.product_id LEFT JOIN product_service ps ON ps.purchase_id = pu.purchase_id
mapper.select: WHERE pu.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY pu.purchased_at, pu.purchase_id
WHERE pu.supplier_id = #{supplierId} ORDER BY pu.purchased_at, pu.purchase_id
WHERE pu.product_id = #{productId} AND ps.service_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ps.serviced_at, ps.service_id
